job.name: s5_eyes
job.prompt: A customer walks up to the pharmacy counter and looks for the pharmacist; they make warm eye contact. The pharmacist in a white coat behind the counter smiles welcomingly. Side view, both faces visible, pharmacy shelves softly blurred behind. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters or labels at all — shelves hold plain colored boxes without any markings.
job.meaning: Первое, что посетитель ищет глазами, когда подходит к столу, — это фармацевт
